w01-night-city.observed_description: A long skyline of tall towers with lit windows at dusk, seen across a river and mirrored in the water.
w01-night-city.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

w02-indoor-market.observed_description: A covered market hall with a high iron-and-glass roof: stalls piled with fruit, vegetables, bread and flowers, and two shoppers seen from behind in the aisle.
w02-indoor-market.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.
